title: Megurine Luka — Photo Contest in SEKAI!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Street SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Alright, let's start coming up with a plan!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: All we really have to do at this point is figure out how we're going to do your makeup, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Then, let's talk while reading through the makeup reference materials Kohane and the others gave us.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Okay♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Hmm... This one says, “Pair some dark chocolate brown eye shadow with blackcurrant lip gloss”...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Oh, that sounds like one for grown-ups! I bet it'll look great on you, Luka!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, it may suit me, but that alone probably won't produce much of an impact...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: A big impact...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Come to think of it, MEIKO's team chose KAITO to be their model, right?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, and he seemed pretty serious about winning those chocolate parfaits. He's probably gonna look really cool.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: He does know how to deliver in these kinds of situations.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: Then, what if we tried going head-to-head with them? Cool versus cool.

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
For example...
The theme for our makeup could be mint chocolate chip.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: It says... “A cool, refreshing and uniquely minty color. A light dusting around your eyes will help capture the hearts of any onlookers!”

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Oh, this is perfect!
It's cool and seems to pack the punch we're looking for!

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line:
See what I mean?
Next, we need to come up with a pose that brings this makeup to life.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, I've already come up with one! I know an amazing trick for blowing people away like that!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: You do?! Can you show us?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Yes, once my makeup's ready♪

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, let's get to work on that!

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line:
Okay.
Yeah!
The day of the photo contest judging
Crase Cafe

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you all for agreeing to gather here on your day off!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: No, I've been looking forward to this ever since you told me about it.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Me too.
Is it true that you and Luka were the models, KAITO...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: Yes! So, let's start with the picture my team took.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Ta-daa! We've got a good feeling about this one!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Whoa, KAITO... Is that really you?!
Your hair's all slicked back...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, you're immediately drawn to his hairstyle, and then his makeup... Looks like there was a lot of thought put into it...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I sorta doubt that.

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
No, that was exactly our plan.
I think we did a good job of directing the viewer's focus if I do say so myself.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Yes, and I like your pose.
All you're doing is sitting in a chair, but you're giving off this aura of success.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you're like a completely different person. In a good way, though.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
Well done, KAITO!
But we also have a good feeling about ours!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Even after seeing how good theirs was? You sound very confident, which means...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Your team's photo must've also turned out really well...!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Alright, here it is!
Ta-daa!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: U-Uhh...

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line: It's not what I was expecting to see...

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Your makeup looks stunning...
This minty color you chose works very nicely.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: R-Right, yeah! You already had this captivating gaze, so it's cool how you were able to make it even more alluring!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, your makeup looks good.
The rest is...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Uh, Luka...? This pose...

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Oh, this? The way you all reacted was priceless! It's that thing where I have someone pinned up against a wall.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Yeah, we know...
But more importantly...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Why do you have a rose in your mouth?!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line:
That? Because it's cool.
Right?

rows.Speaker: Miku & Rin
rows.Line:
*Nod*
Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, that is pretty cool!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, what...?

rows.Speaker: KAITO
rows.Line:
Haha...
I guess that's one way to put it.

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line:
I suppose...
And they seem rather proud of what they've achieved.

rows.Speaker: Len & KAITO
rows.Line: Let's eat!

rows.Speaker: MEIKO
rows.Line: Enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: KAITO's team ended up winning...

rows.Speaker: Miku
rows.Line: We were basically tied on makeup, but we lost because of the pose we chose.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Yeah, we were so close.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: Thank you for lending us your makeup and those reference materials. They really helped!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: We were able to have a fun contest as a result.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
I'm glad I could help!
I also had a lot of fun as a judge!

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: You did? Then, we might just have to do this again sometime♪

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yes, you definitely should!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You might wanna give them some stuff on posing then...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: To be fair, that was an interesting choice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I agree.

rows.Speaker: Luka
rows.Line: So, Miku, Rin, if we do have another contest, would you like to be on the same team then?

rows.Speaker: Rin & Miku
rows.Line:
Of course!
Of course.
